diff --git a/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..d9c14d00e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,293 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         *bool
+	headers         []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	cookies         []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	queryParameters []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	filterState     []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	sourceIp        *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return reflect.DeepEqual(c, otherCH)
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != nil && *c.disable {
+		if len(c.headers) > 0 || len(c.cookies) > 0 || len(c.queryParameters) > 0 || len(c.filterState) > 0 || c.sourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in header %s: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		if ck.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseTTL(ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl %q for cookie %s: %w", ck.TTL, ck.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         ch.Disable,
+		headers:         deduplicateHeaders(ch.Headers),
+		cookies:         deduplicateCookies(ch.Cookies),
+		queryParameters: deduplicateQueryParams(ch.QueryParameters),
+		filterState:     deduplicateFilterState(ch.FilterState),
+		sourceIp:        ch.SourceIP,
+	}
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ir *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if ir == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if ir.disable != nil && *ir.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	action.HashPolicy = buildEnvoyHashPolicies(ir)
+}
+
+func buildEnvoyHashPolicies(ir *consistentHashIR) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	isEmpty := len(ir.headers) == 0 && len(ir.cookies) == 0 && len(ir.queryParameters) == 0 && len(ir.filterState) == 0 && ir.sourceIp == nil
+	if isEmpty {
+		// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range ir.headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if h.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *h.Terminal
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.GetHeader().RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, c := range ir.cookies {
+		cookieSpec := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: c.Path,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			if dur, err := parseTTL(c.TTL); err == nil {
+				cookieSpec.Ttl = durationpb.New(dur)
+			}
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookieSpec.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookieSpec,
+			},
+		}
+		if c.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *c.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. Query Parameters
+	for _, qp := range ir.queryParameters {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if qp.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *qp.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. Filter State
+	for _, fs := range ir.filterState {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if fs.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *fs.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. Source IP
+	if ir.sourceIp != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if ir.sourceIp.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *ir.sourceIp.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}
+
+func parseTTL(ttl string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if ttl == "" {
+		return 0, nil
+	}
+	dur, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err == nil {
+		return dur, nil
+	}
+	secs, err2 := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64)
+	if err2 == nil {
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl duration: %s", ttl)
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, 0, len(headers))
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if !seen[key] {
+			seen[key] = true
+			result = append(result, h)
+		}
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateCookies(cookies []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie {
+	if len(cookies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie, 0, len(cookies))
+	for _, c := range cookies {
+		if !seen[c.Name] {
+			seen[c.Name] = true
+			result = append(result, c)
+		}
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateQueryParams(params []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter {
+	if len(params) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter, 0, len(params))
+	for _, p := range params {
+		if !seen[p.Name] {
+			seen[p.Name] = true
+			result = append(result, p)
+		}
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateFilterState(fs []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState {
+	if len(fs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, 0, len(fs))
+	for _, f := range fs {
+		if !seen[f.Key] {
+			seen[f.Key] = true
+			result = append(result, f)
+		}
+	}
+	return result
+}

+func TestConsistentHash_Merge(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("union array fields with higher priority first, deduplicated", func(t *testing.T) {
+		p1 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+						{HeaderName: "X-Common", Terminal: ptr.To(true)},
+						{HeaderName: "X-P1"},
+					},
+					cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+						{Name: "session"},
+					},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		p2 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+						{HeaderName: "x-common", Terminal: ptr.To(false)},
+						{HeaderName: "X-P2"},
+					},
+					cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+						{Name: "session"},
+						{Name: "tracking"},
+					},
+					queryParameters: []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter{
+						{Name: "q1"},
+					},
+					sourceIp: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: ptr.To(true)},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+
+		p2Ref := &ir.AttachedPolicyRef{}
+		mergeOrigins := ir.MergeOrigins{}
+
+		mergeConsistentHash(p1, p2, p2Ref, ir.MergeOrigins{}, policy.MergeOptions{}, mergeOrigins, TrafficPolicyMergeOpts{})
+
+		ch := p1.spec.consistentHash
+		require.NotNil(t, ch)
+
+		// Headers: X-Common from p1 kept (terminal=true), X-P1, X-P2 from p2
+		require.Len(t, ch.headers, 3)
+		assert.Equal(t, "X-Common", ch.headers[0].HeaderName)
+		assert.True(t, *ch.headers[0].Terminal)
+		assert.Equal(t, "X-P1", ch.headers[1].HeaderName)
+		assert.Equal(t, "X-P2", ch.headers[2].HeaderName)
+
+		// Cookies: session from p1 kept, tracking added
+		require.Len(t, ch.cookies, 2)
+		assert.Equal(t, "session", ch.cookies[0].Name)
+		assert.Equal(t, "tracking", ch.cookies[1].Name)
+
+		// QueryParams: q1 added
+		require.Len(t, ch.queryParameters, 1)
+
+		// SourceIP: retained p1's value (which was nil!), so sourceIp remains nil
+		assert.Nil(t, ch.sourceIp)
+
+		// Merge metadata: "consistentHash" recorded
+		assert.Contains(t, mergeOrigins, "consistentHash")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("sourceIp retains higher priority value when set", func(t *testing.T) {
+		p1 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					sourceIp: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: ptr.To(false)},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		p2 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					sourceIp: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: ptr.To(true)},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+
+		p2Ref := &ir.AttachedPolicyRef{}
+		mergeOrigins := ir.MergeOrigins{}
+
+		mergeConsistentHash(p1, p2, p2Ref, ir.MergeOrigins{}, policy.MergeOptions{}, mergeOrigins, TrafficPolicyMergeOpts{})
+
+		ch := p1.spec.consistentHash
+		require.NotNil(t, ch)
+		require.NotNil(t, ch.sourceIp)
+		assert.False(t, *ch.sourceIp.Terminal)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("disable on higher priority suppresses lower priority", func(t *testing.T) {
+		p1 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					disable: ptr.To(true),
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		p2 := &TrafficPolicy{
+			spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+				consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+					headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+						{HeaderName: "X-Header"},
+					},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+
+		mergeConsistentHash(p1, p2, &ir.AttachedPolicyRef{}, ir.MergeOrigins{}, policy.MergeOptions{}, ir.MergeOrigins{}, TrafficPolicyMergeOpts{})
+
+		ch := p1.spec.consistentHash
+		require.NotNil(t, ch)
+		assert.True(t, *ch.disable)
+		assert.Empty(t, ch.headers)
+	})
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	p1Val := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	p2Val := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if p2Val == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1Val == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2Val
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Both p1Val and p2Val are set.
+	// If higher-priority p1 disables consistentHash, it suppresses p2.
+	if p1Val.disable != nil && *p1Val.disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Merge array fields: union p1 and p2 entries (p1 first), deduplicated by key.
+	mergedHeaders := deduplicateHeaders(append(slices.Clone(p1Val.headers), p2Val.headers...))
+	mergedCookies := deduplicateCookies(append(slices.Clone(p1Val.cookies), p2Val.cookies...))
+	mergedQueryParams := deduplicateQueryParams(append(slices.Clone(p1Val.queryParameters), p2Val.queryParameters...))
+	mergedFilterState := deduplicateFilterState(append(slices.Clone(p1Val.filterState), p2Val.filterState...))
+
+	contributed := len(mergedHeaders) > len(p1Val.headers) ||
+		len(mergedCookies) > len(p1Val.cookies) ||
+		len(mergedQueryParams) > len(p1Val.queryParameters) ||
+		len(mergedFilterState) > len(p1Val.filterState)
+
+	p1Val.headers = mergedHeaders
+	p1Val.cookies = mergedCookies
+	p1Val.queryParameters = mergedQueryParams
+	p1Val.filterState = mergedFilterState
+
+	// Scalar sourceIp: retains higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	// Since p1Val != nil, p1Val.sourceIp is retained as is.
+
+	if contributed {
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+	}
